answer: In a marble-like system, each node issues verifiable delay commitments to its history of interactions; these commitments, similar to a ripple effect, enhance transparency and traceability. A fable of interconnected cryptographic layers ensures that any attempt to clone or spoof identities—that might otherwise seem plausible in a decentralized network—faces an insurmountable computational obstacle, mirroring the relentless progression of a verifiable delay function that ensures honesty and prevents any form of identity marbling or fraudulent actions.
